author: Sunflower State News
title: Sedgwick County Sheriff's Office to hold press conference on May 4 shooting
text:
The Sedgwick County Sheriff’s Office announced on May 6 that it will hold a press conference today at 3:30 p.m. to provide an update about the officer-involved shooting that took place on May 4 involving a Wichita Police officer.
The event is set to take place in the Kevin Easter Conference Room, located on the second floor of the Sedgwick County Adult Detention Facility at 141 W. Elm.
Officials say this press conference aims to inform the public and media about developments related to the incident. The shooting has drawn attention from both local residents and law enforcement observers seeking more details about what occurred.
No additional information regarding the circumstances of the shooting or those involved was provided in this announcement. Further updates are expected during or after today’s scheduled briefing.
The broader community continues to follow updates closely as authorities prepare to share new information.
